care_team_notes: Ask the MND team to identify the cause of pain before choosing treatment; include sleep impact, mood, swallowing ability, constipation, pressure risk and medication side effects.
description: MND-specific guidance on pain and discomfort caused by weakness, stiffness, immobility, cramps, spasms, pressure sores, constipation, head-drop and pre-existing conditions.
name: Pain and discomfort in MND

care_team_notes: Review cramps and spasticity regularly; consider physio/OT, positioning, passive range-of-motion, orthoses, safe transfers, pressure relief and clinician-led medication review.
description: Professional guidance on pain, cramps, spasticity, joint support, positioning, passive movements, orthoses, physiotherapy, hydrotherapy and medicines.
name: Movement, joints, cramps and spasticity

care_team_notes: Regular, severe, new or prolonged cramps should be discussed with the treating doctor, especially if there is swelling, redness, warmth, weakness, numbness, breathlessness or chest pain.
description: Australian general guidance on calf pain and cramps, including stretching, massage, hydration considerations and red flags such as possible deep vein thrombosis.
name: Muscle cramps and calf pain

care_team_notes: Escalate early redness, discolouration, blistering, broken skin, pain over bony areas or inability to reposition independently to nursing/medical/OT teams.
description: Pain prevention related to immobility, skin pressure, support surfaces, special cushions/mattresses and regular repositioning.
name: Positioning, pressure pain and skin protection

care_team_notes: Constipation in MND may relate to reduced mobility, fluids, diet changes, swallowing, medicines or opioids; ask the GP/nurse/dietitian for an individual bowel plan.
description: Australian general guidance on constipation as a cause of discomfort and pain, including self-care, medicines and when medical advice is needed.
name: Constipation-related discomfort

care_team_notes: Do not start, stop or change medicines without a clinician/pharmacist review; check swallowing difficulty, respiratory status, constipation, sedation, falls risk and interactions.
description: General Australian medication and pain-management context covering simple analgesics, anti-inflammatory medicines, opioids, chronic pain review and non-drug approaches.
name: Pain medicines and medication review
